⚙️ Fee Categories Admin Only

Add, rename or remove fee categories. Changes take effect the next time you set up a fee schedule. Tip: use "Grade restriction" to limit a category to JHS only (e.g. BECE Registration) or a specific grade.

➕ New Fee Category

🧾 Import Term Bills Admin Only

Load a whole term's bills from the class workbooks in one go. Students are matched by name, and you see exactly what will happen before anything is written. Fee amounts, arrears, discounts and sponsorship are replaced from the file; payments already recorded are kept.

🚌 Bus Fee Rates Admin Only

The monthly bus fee for each grade group. These amounts appear on class bills and on each bus rider's account, so a rate left at 0 means no bus fee is billed for that group.

⚡ Early Payment Discount Admin Only

Set a date window at the start of each term. If a student pays their full term balance within this period, the discount is automatically applied to their tuition.

🎓 Grade Promotion Admin Only

Promotes all students to their next grade level. JHS Form 3 students are marked as Graduated. This normally runs automatically on August 1st each year, but you can also trigger it manually here.

⚠️ This resets all fee records and sets the active term back to Term 1. Only run this at the start of a new academic year.

👥 User Management Admin Only

Manage who can access the system. Admin accounts can do everything. Staff accounts can view student accounts and record payments, but cannot add/delete students, change settings, or manage users.

➕ Pre-approve a staff member

Type the part of their school email before @cormghana.org. They sign in with Google as usual and go straight in, with no approval step. Anyone not pre-approved appears above as a request.

🗑️ Reset System

This will delete ALL student records. This cannot be undone.
